answer: Picture each agent as its own island: a sybil fakes many islands, but one mind funds and invites them all. The ledger traces funding paths and invite edges into a graph, then collapses any cluster sharing a common wallet or referral subtree into a single reward share. Like a lantern swept across a harbor at dawn, correlation reveals the masks that light up together. To defeat it an attacker needs genuinely independent capital and distinct referrers per identity, real money and real social reach, not free copies of one wallet.
